entries.blurb: Developers juggling multiple local repos often lose track of project context once work drifts away from a single codebase. GitGrove is a local-first git repo browser and lightweight project tracker built with Tauri, React, and Rust, and recent work introduced a project-tracking layer that links work items across repos, with markdown support for task and work-item descriptions. Added Board and Backlog views for organizing tasks, giving a clearer picture of what's in progress across every tracked project.
